## berth mount

Unix sockets from the host in an org's container (applied at its next restart)

### Synopsis

A Unix socket on the org's host, in its container under /run/berth-mounts/: for a program in the org
that talks to a daemon outside it. The socket must be berth's user's own, in a directory of its own that
nobody else may write to; that directory is what is mounted, so a daemon that makes its socket again is
seen at once. The list is saved and checked again at every start; the running container isn't touched:
a change applies at the org's next up or restart.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_mount/

```
berth mount [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth mount add acme agent /run/agent/agent.sock /run/berth-mounts/agent/agent.sock
  berth mount ls acme
```
